title: 第1738章 身份确认投毒第1737章 成功但没完全成功监视
slug: 玄幻反派仙域最强太子爷
content_zh:
…………
半日后。
绝冥山脉深处，大殿中心位置。
五长老已经收集到了足够的情报，不敢有丝毫怠慢，立刻前来汇报消息。
“参见教主大人，根据我刚刚收到的消息，我们冥鬼教位于阴冥山脉的分部，确实已经被覆灭了。
阴冥山脉损毁严重，就连其附近附属的魔族城镇，也出了问题。
从现场的情况来看，对方修炼的并非是魔族功法，现场除了煞力之外，还有灵力残留。”
“果然！”
冥鬼教主一眯眼，心中涌现出浓烈的杀意。
不是修炼魔族功法，现场还有灵力残留，足以说明这件事情和人族恐怕有不小的关系。
魔族修炼只会汲取煞力而不是灵力，自然不会有残留的灵力出现。
“哼！人族那些家伙竟然偷偷摸摸的对我冥鬼教分部下手，此事绝对不能就这么算了。”
在冥鬼教主眼中，这件事情是人族做的，板上钉钉。
至于到底是谁做的这件事情，目前还一无所知。
可无论是谁做的这件事情，都和人族脱不了干系。
“对了，那家伙呢？他是分部的护法吗？”
冥鬼教主可没有忘记，魔傀自述的身份。
至于这个身份的真假，要想查明并不难。
五长老点点头，讲述了对魔傀的调查结果。
“教主，根据调查，阴冥山脉分部的确有一个护法名为魔罗，特征也吻合，应该就是他没错。”

确定了对方的身份，冥鬼教主心中不疑有他。
之前他对魔傀有所怀疑，而魔傀所说的那些话，他也只是将信将疑。
经过调查，对方身份无误，分部发生的事情也核对得上，自然也就没有怀疑的必要。
“让他好生休养，既然分部没了，就让他留在总部，该给的奖赏不能少。
能从分部覆灭之中成功逃出来，也算是有些气运，好好培养他，对我冥鬼教也是好事。
监视他的两个魔族，也可以撤了。”
能在身负重伤的情况下赶来报信，能活下来也是他的机缘。
教主既然都已经这么说了，五长老自然是连忙应下。
“明白，教主放心，属下立刻去安排。”
在五长老离开后，冥鬼教主脸色又阴沉了许多。
冥鬼教一共就那么几个分部，现在直接被灭了一个，对于冥鬼教而言，打击可不小。
最大的问题是，虽然知道分部的覆灭和人族有关，可具体是谁做的却不清楚。
虽然冥鬼教实力不弱，但若是对上整个人族，还是不够看。
想拉其他魔族下水的可能性也不大，除非三大魔宗愿意倾力相助。
可要想让三大魔宗倾力相助，谈何容易。
没有谁威胁到三大魔宗的至高利益，他们没有出手的理由。
事情还需要细查，最好是能弄清楚，究竟是谁做的这件事情。
有针对性地进行报复，才能以最小的损失完成复仇。
…………
五长老来到魔傀休养的地方，直接让外面看守的两个魔族修士退下。
content_en:
…………
Half a day later.
Deep in the Jueming Mountains, in the center of the main hall.
The fifth elder had already collected enough information and did not dare to neglect at all, so he immediately came to report the news.
"See Master, according to the news I just received, our branch of the Netherworld Sect located in the Yinming Mountains has indeed been destroyed.
The Yinming Mountains were severely damaged, and even the nearby demon towns had problems.
Judging from the situation at the scene, the opponent was not practicing demonic skills. In addition to the evil force, there was also spiritual power left at the scene. "
"Sure enough!"
The leader of the ghost ghost squinted his eyes, and a strong murderous intention emerged in his heart.
Rather than practicing demonic skills, there was still spiritual power left at the scene, which is enough to show that this matter may have a lot to do with the human race.
Demonic training will only draw evil power instead of spiritual power, so naturally there will be no residual spiritual power.
"Hmph! Those guys from the human race actually secretly attacked my branch of the Underworld Cult. This matter must not be left alone."
In the eyes of the Underworld Cult Leader, this matter was done by the human race, and it was certain.
As for who did this, it is still unknown.
But no matter who did this, it has something to do with the human race.
"By the way, where is that guy? Is he the guardian of the branch?"
The leader of the ghost ghost has not forgotten the identity of the demon puppet.
As for the authenticity of this identity, it is not difficult to find out.
The fifth elder nodded and told the results of the investigation into the demon puppet.
"Leader, according to the investigation, there is indeed a protector named Mo Luo in the Yinming Mountains Branch, and the characteristics are consistent. It should be him."
After confirming the identity of the other party, the ghost leader had no doubt about him.
He had doubts about the demon puppet before, and he only half-believed what the demon puppet said.
After investigation, it was found that the identity of the other party was correct, and what happened in the branch was also verified, so there was no need for doubt.
"Let him have a good rest. Since the branch is gone, let him stay at the headquarters. The reward should be no less.
Being able to successfully escape from the destruction of the branch can be regarded as a bit of luck. It will also be a good thing for our Nether Ghost Sect to train him well.
The two demons monitoring him can also withdraw. "
He was able to come to report the news even though he was seriously injured, and it was his chance to survive.
Since the leader had already said this, the fifth elder naturally agreed immediately.
"Understood, leader, don't worry, my subordinates will make arrangements immediately."
After the fifth elder left, the Ghost Leader's expression became much gloomier.
There are only a few branches of the Underworld Cult, and now one of them has been directly destroyed. For the Underworld Cult, the blow is not small.
The biggest problem is that although it is known that the destruction of the branch is related to the human race, it is not clear who did it.
Although the Ghost Sect is not weak in strength, it is still not enough against the entire human race.
It is unlikely that other demons will be lured into the situation, unless the three major demon sects are willing to help.
But it's not easy to get the three major demon sects to help each other.
No one threatens the supreme interests of the three demon sects, and they have no reason to take action.
The matter still needs to be investigated carefully, and it is best to find out who did it.
Only by retaliating in a targeted manner can revenge be accomplished with minimal loss.
…………
The fifth elder came to the place where the demon puppet was resting and asked the two demon monks guarding outside to retreat.
